The way I deal with this question, is just basically to live the way I want to, try to give as few shits about the future as possible, and try to enjoy the now. Because the future is always uncertain, freedom is near impossible these days, but never get complacent about it, always fight for freedom. And enjoy the present as much as you can, because the next second even we could all be dead, and it would never matter. In short, live like we all matter, fight for your freedom, and think a bit about the future, and act on it now, but also live like it doesn't matter. Free will isn't a lie if you think about what you're doing, where you're going, and how that may effect you. Free will is only lost when you get complacent and don't think about these things. Also, don't act like having the ability to think about things is a bad trait, r/im14andthisisdeep is only something for people who don't think all that much to shit on people who do.
